compiled_state.title: Plugin scripts reference tests/fixtures paths not shipped in plugin cache
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
Several plugin scripts reference fixture or corpus paths that exist in the development repo's tests/ tree but DO NOT ship inside plugins/dso/ in the marketplace-distributed cache. On a host project running via the shim, the paths resolve to non-existent locations.

Affected scripts:
- inference-recall-replay.sh:13-14 — defaults to tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/...
- preconditions-coverage-harness.sh:41 — _DEFAULT_CORPUS=\$_REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/818-corpus/sample-bugs.json
- dogfood-gov-copy.sh:32 — BASELINE=\${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tests/fixtures/dogfood/bad-copy-baseline.yaml
- check-test-isolation.sh:34 — RULES_DIR=\$REPO_ROOT/scripts/test-isolation-rules (relates to a530)

This issue is masked today by the broken REPO_ROOT=SCRIPT_DIR/.. pattern (separate bugs 34b2/3706/a530) which makes REPO_ROOT resolve to the plugin tree. Once those are fixed, missing-resource errors will surface.

## Fix options
A. Move fixtures into plugins/dso/data/fixtures/ (or plugins/dso/resources/) and update scripts to use \${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/data/fixtures/...
B. Tag the scripts as plugin-self-test-only and remove them from the shim allowlist (host can't invoke them).

(A) is preferable for any script that is genuinely useful on a host project; (B) for purely internal dogfooding tooling.

## Discovered by
Opus audit subagent on 2026-05-28 during PR-4 host-portability review.

comments.body:
fix-bug:investigation

## Root Cause Analysis (Five-Whys)

**WHY 1**: Three plugin scripts fail on host projects.
- inference-recall-replay.sh: exits with CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT (soft fail)
- preconditions-coverage-harness.sh: exits with 'ERROR: corpus file not found'
- dogfood-gov-copy.sh: exits with 'error: baseline artifact not found' (also broken in dev repo)

**WHY 2**: The scripts reference fixture paths that don't exist on host projects.
- inference-recall-replay.sh lines 13-14: INCIDENTS_FILE defaults to CWD-relative 'tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/incidents.jsonl'
- preconditions-coverage-harness.sh line 41: _DEFAULT_CORPUS=$_REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/818-corpus/sample-bugs.json
- dogfood-gov-copy.sh lines 32-33: BASELINE/IMPROVED = ${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tests/fixtures/dogfood/ (wrong subdir -- plugins/dso/tests/ doesn't exist)

**WHY 3**: The fixtures live under tests/fixtures/ in the dev repo, which is NOT packaged into plugins/dso/ for distribution.

**WHY 4**: No one relocated the seed fixtures when the scripts were added (they were written assuming dev-repo context).

**WHY 5**: The plugin boundary allowlist governs only plugins/dso/ content -- tests/ content is not distributed.

## Empirical Evidence

- OBSERVED: dogfood-gov-copy.sh fails immediately in dev repo: 'error: baseline artifact not found: ${repo}/plugins/dso/tests/fixtures/dogfood/bad-copy-baseline.yaml' (plugins/dso/tests/ does NOT exist)
- OBSERVED: preconditions-coverage-harness.sh works from dev repo root but fails on a fake host (git init + run from host root): 'ERROR: corpus file not found: /tmp/fake-host.X/tests/fixtures/818-corpus/sample-bugs.json'
- OBSERVED: inference-recall-replay.sh fails on fake host with CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT (grep exit on missing file, silenced by || true)
- DOCUMENTED: plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf already covers plugins/dso/data/** -- no allowlist change required
- DOCUMENTED: retro SKILL.md line 316 has an existing skip condition for missing tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/ (partial mitigation)

## Root Cause Candidates

**RC1 (CONFIRMED, HIGH CONFIDENCE)**: Scripts were authored using dev-repo-relative paths but shipped as plugin artifacts. The seed fixture files need to be relocated to plugins/dso/data/fixtures/ so they are present in the distributed plugin cache.

**RC2 (CONFIRMED, dogfood-gov-copy.sh specifically)**: dogfood-gov-copy.sh incorrectly constructs its fixture path as _PLUGIN_ROOT/tests/fixtures/dogfood/ -- but plugins/dso/tests/ doesn't exist. This is a path-construction error that fails in the dev repo itself, not just on host projects.

## Fix Plan

**Scope** (Option A from ticket description -- relocate fixtures):

**New files to create** (copy from tests/fixtures/):
- plugins/dso/data/fixtures/inference-incidents/incidents.jsonl
- plugins/dso/data/fixtures/inference-incidents/holdout.txt
- plugins/dso/data/fixtures/818-corpus/sample-bugs.json
- plugins/dso/data/fixtures/dogfood/bad-copy-baseline.yaml
- plugins/dso/data/fixtures/dogfood/good-copy-improved.yaml

**Script changes** (update default paths to plugin-relative):
- plugins/dso/scripts/inference-recall-replay.sh line 13-14: change defaults to ${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/data/fixtures/inference-incidents/...
- plugins/dso/scripts/preconditions-coverage-harness.sh line 41: change _DEFAULT_CORPUS to $_PLUGIN_ROOT/data/fixtures/818-corpus/sample-bugs.json
- plugins/dso/scripts/dogfood-gov-copy.sh lines 32-33: change BASELINE/IMPROVED to ${_PLUGIN_ROOT}/data/fixtures/dogfood/...

**Skill/doc changes** (update hardcoded tests/fixtures paths):
- plugins/dso/skills/retro/SKILL.md lines 214,217,257,279,280,316: update inference-incidents paths to use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/data/fixtures/inference-incidents/ (or relative _PLUGIN_ROOT variable)
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inference-recall-result.md lines 86-87: update invocation example

**Allowlist**: plugins/dso/data/** is already in plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf -- no change needed.

**Test changes**: The existing tests already pass --corpus or INCIDENTS_FILE overrides, so they don't rely on the broken defaults. A portability regression test should be added to confirm defaults work from a directory without tests/fixtures/.

## Complexity Assessment: MODERATE
- Multiple files (5 scripts/skills + 5 new fixture copies)
- Straightforward mechanical path relocation -- no logic changes
- One file (retro SKILL.md) is an LLM-behavioral file -- changes are path/variable updates only, not behavioral guidance

## SCRATCH_KEY: fix-bug:investigation
